capabilities.name: Vital-sign recording
capabilities.description: Measure and record temperature, pulse, respiration, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, pain score.

capabilities.name: Patient triage
capabilities.description: Assess patient acuity and prioritize care based on clinical need.

capabilities.name: Clinical history
capabilities.description: Take and document patient history including presenting complaint, history of present illness, past medical history, medications, allergies.

capabilities.name: Physical examination
capabilities.description: Perform systematic physical examination appropriate to clinical context.

capabilities.name: Diagnosis
capabilities.description: Formulate working diagnosis based on history, examination and investigation findings.

capabilities.name: Differential diagnosis
capabilities.description: Generate and evaluate differential diagnoses.

capabilities.name: Laboratory ordering
capabilities.description: Order laboratory investigations and specify specimen requirements.

capabilities.name: Imaging ordering
capabilities.description: Order diagnostic imaging investigations with clinical justification.

capabilities.name: Laboratory result validation
capabilities.description: Review, validate and interpret laboratory results.

capabilities.name: Imaging interpretation
capabilities.description: Interpret diagnostic imaging studies and produce reports.

capabilities.name: Prescribing
capabilities.description: Prescribe medications including dose, route, frequency and duration.

capabilities.name: Medication dispensing
capabilities.description: Dispense medications with appropriate counselling and checks.

capabilities.name: Medication administration
capabilities.description: Administer medications via appropriate routes with patient verification.

capabilities.name: Clinical procedures
capabilities.description: Perform clinical procedures within scope of practice.

capabilities.name: Suturing
capabilities.description: Perform wound closure including suturing, tissue adhesive and staples.

capabilities.name: Wound care
capabilities.description: Assess, clean, dress and manage wounds.

capabilities.name: Vaccination
capabilities.description: Administer vaccines with appropriate screening and documentation.

capabilities.name: Antenatal care
capabilities.description: Provide antenatal assessment, monitoring and care.

capabilities.name: Delivery and maternity care
capabilities.description: Manage labour, conduct delivery and provide immediate postpartum care.

capabilities.name: Neonatal resuscitation
capabilities.description: Perform neonatal resuscitation including bag-mask ventilation and chest compressions.

capabilities.name: Anaesthesia
capabilities.description: Administer general, regional and local anaesthesia.

capabilities.name: Sedation
capabilities.description: Provide conscious sedation with appropriate monitoring.

capabilities.name: Surgery
capabilities.description: Perform surgical procedures within scope of practice.

capabilities.name: Dental procedures
capabilities.description: Perform dental procedures including restoration, extraction and oral surgery.

capabilities.name: Ophthalmic procedures
capabilities.description: Perform ophthalmic procedures including refraction, slit-lamp examination and minor surgery.

capabilities.name: Mental-health assessment
capabilities.description: Assess mental health status including risk assessment.

capabilities.name: Counselling
capabilities.description: Provide psychological counselling and support.

capabilities.name: Psychotherapy
capabilities.description: Provide evidence-based psychotherapy interventions.

capabilities.name: Physiotherapy
capabilities.description: Assess and treat physical dysfunction through exercise, manual therapy and modalities.

capabilities.name: Occupational therapy
capabilities.description: Assess and treat functional limitations through therapeutic activities.

capabilities.name: Speech therapy
capabilities.description: Assess and treat communication and swallowing disorders.

capabilities.name: Clinical referrals
capabilities.description: Make and manage clinical referrals to other services.

capabilities.name: Discharge authorization
capabilities.description: Authorize patient discharge with appropriate follow-up plans.

capabilities.name: Clinical note signing
capabilities.description: Sign clinical notes and documents with professional accountability.

capabilities.name: Clinical note amendment
capabilities.description: Amend clinical notes with audit trail.
